claims.excerpt: Before the impact, Dimorphos took 11 hours and 55 minutes to orbit the larger asteroid Didymos.
claims.label: F0
claims.sourceEvidence: Before impact, Dimorphos took 11 hours and 55 minutes to orbit the larger asteroid Didymos.

claims.narrativeStatement: Before impact, Dimorphos took 11 hours and 55 minutes to orbit the larger asteroid Didymos.

claims.excerpt: Immediately afterward, its orbital period was 11 hours, 22 minutes and 37 seconds—a shortening of 32 minutes and 42 seconds.

claims.sourceEvidence: Immediately after impact, the period shortened by 32 minutes and 42 seconds, to 11 hours, 22 minutes and 37 seconds.

claims.narrativeStatement: Immediately after impact, the period shortened by 32 minutes and 42 seconds, to 11 hours, 22 minutes and 37 seconds.
claims.explanation: Preserves both the immediate post-impact period and its reduction from baseline.

claims.excerpt: Over the following weeks, Dimorphos lost more rocky material to space as its orbital period continued to shorten.
